noise_floor.conclusion: The frozen 15 dB noise-floor incremental-gain gate fails because shipping AGC converges to the explicit 8x maximum-gain clamp when no far-end-only prohibition is active. The result is deterministic across all six exposed regression cases.

double_talk_activity.balanced_case_interpretation: Most missed balanced near+far frames satisfy the frozen instant hold proxy but fail the smoothed on-gate, identifying state admission as the dominant limitation on these exposed cases.
double_talk_activity.weak_near_interpretation: All three weak-near cases are dominated by simultaneous smoothed and instant on-gate failure; this is an activity-control dependency rather than evidence to tune AGC target, limiter, attack or release.
double_talk_activity.conclusion: All six exposed double-talk gaps are explained by the current activity ratio predicates; none requires an AGC parameter search.

reviewed_candidate_authority.basis: The value is the pre-registered I006 noise-floor max_p95_frame_gain_db gate, not a post-result grid or ranking outcome.
forbidden: activity ratio threshold change or search
required_protection: noise-floor incremental p95 frame gain <= 15.0 dB in all exposed cases
pure far-end output-vs-input gain <= 0.75 dB and far-only activity precondition remains valid
near/far paired AGC speech SI-SDR delta >= -0.50 dB
no clip-fraction regression beyond frozen I006 gates
no behavior change to activity-control predicates
